description: Ship-brain micro-model: predicts per-module steering weights from a 20-float ship state vector.

architecture.forward_pass: h = tanh(W1 @ x + b1);  out = sigmoid(W2 @ h + b2)

outputs.name: ObjectiveModule
outputs.description: Weight for driving toward / holding the team objective area

outputs.name: FlockingModule
outputs.description: Weight for staying in formation with friendly ships

outputs.name: EvasionModule
outputs.description: Weight for dodging and retreating from incoming fire

outputs.name: AttackModule
outputs.description: Weight for manoeuvring to establish / hold a firing solution

normalization.description: Apply these transforms to raw game values before passing to the model. All outputs should be in [0,1] except closing_speed which is in (-1,1).

features.name: has_target
features.raw_description: whether an alive target is tracked
features.formula: float(target is not None and target.is_alive())

features.name: target_hp_frac
features.raw_description: target's current HP / target's max HP

features.name: closing_speed
features.raw_description: relative approach speed along the line to target (px/s, positive = closing)
features.notes: dot product of (ship_velocity - target_velocity) onto the unit vector pointing from ship toward target; positive = approaching, negative = retreating

features.name: can_fire
features.raw_description: weapon is loaded, target in range, within fire arc, and LoS is clear
features.formula: float(loaded AND in_range AND in_arc AND clear_los)
features.edge_case: 0.0 when no target or weapon is reloading

features.name: friend_count
features.raw_description: number of alive friendly ships within visual_range

features.name: enemy_count
features.raw_description: number of alive enemy ships within visual_range

features.name: inside_objective
features.raw_description: ship is within the patrol ring of the team objective
